patch_description:
This candidate ansatz is a crossover combining the compact symmetry-aware single-qubit sharing from one parent with the parametrized controlled-rotation entangling motif from the other. The ansatz:
- Groups single-qubit rotations by board symmetry (corners, edges, center) to reduce parameters and regularize learning.
- Adds a small RZ periphery vs center phase to break parity symmetry.
- Uses parametrized CRX on ring edges and CRZ on spokes to the hub, reusing a single entangling RX parameter for both CRX entanglement and RX mixing to keep parameter count low while boosting tunable entanglement.
- Ends with a compact shared RY output layer (periphery vs center) for sharper class boundaries.

Design goals:
- Keep N_PARAMS_PER_BLOCK small and consistent (9 keys) so training budget and optimizer settings remain aligned with the fixed training loop.
- Use parameter sharing to improve parameter efficiency and regularize the model.
- Favor CRX/CRZ entangling (richer than only CZ) to improve expressivity without inflating the parameter count.

This program preserves the original inputs/outputs and training loop while replacing only the ANSATZ_SPEC inside the EVOLVE block.
